method: Nearest source point in native WGS84 coordinate space, then WGS84 ellipsoid geodesic point-to-point distance. This is contextual distance to an actual source point, not a guaranteed geodesic minimum to every segment.
limits: The provider says most lines are within100m, not every point and not a guaranteed error bound. This grouping is not an eligibility rule.
Source coordinates and all original/native identities are unchanged. No snapping, tolerance tuning, physical inference, legal-boundary adoption or repair.
